title: Product Manager – AI & Software Delivery
description:
### **Ideas are easy. Launches are hard. You make them happen.**

Most projects don’t fail in the code. They fail in the gaps: a requirement nobody clarified, a handoff that slipped, a risk everyone noticed but no one raised. You’re the person who closes those gaps.

At Techdome, we build AI-first products for clients across FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Our engineers, designers, and AI specialists are strong. What we need is a Product Manager who can give that talent direction, momentum, and a clear finish line.

### **What You’ll Own**

You’ll lead products from the first discovery call to launch day and beyond. Some will be classic software platforms. Many will be at the frontier: LLM-powered applications, intelligent chatbots, autonomous AI agents, and end-to-end automation. Every one of them will need to ship on time, stay within budget, and move the numbers our clients care about.

### **What Your Week Looks Like**

* **Turning vision into a plan:** Define scope, goals, milestones, timelines, and budgets that are bold but grounded in technical reality.
* **Keeping every team in lockstep:** Align UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so work moves forward without friction or dropped handoffs.
* **Taking AI from demo to production:** Work closely with engineers and ML specialists to turn promising prototypes into reliable, scalable AI products real users depend on.
* **Becoming fluent in your client’s world:** Learn their industry, regulations, and compliance requirements, then convert them into requirements your team can build without guesswork.
* **Leading people and partners:** Plan team capacity, manage third-party vendors, and hold everyone accountable to clear expectations.
* **Spotting trouble early:** Run structured change control and flag technical, delivery, and AI-specific risks while they’re still small.
* **Telling it like it is:** Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give clients and leadership honest, no-surprises updates.
* **Working smarter with AI:** Keep documentation crisp and use AI tools to speed up planning, tracking, and reporting.

### **What Success Looks Like**

**In your first 30 days,** you’ll learn our delivery process, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects.

**By 60 days,** you’ll be leading at least one project independently, owning the plan, the risks, and the client relationship.

**By 90 days,** you’ll have delivered a key milestone, strengthened how we run projects, and earned the trust of your team and clients.

### **You’ll Thrive Here If You Have**

* 2+ years as a Product Manager shipping complex software projects on time and on budget.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across design, engineering, QA, and DevOps.
* Command of Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall, plus tools like JIRA, Azure DevOps, Trello, or Asana.
* Real technical depth across the SDLC, APIs, microservices, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and CI/CD, enough to push back on estimates and earn engineers’ respect.
* Hands-on GenAI or AI/ML experience, with a clear understanding of the AI lifecycle and its risks: privacy, bias, hallucinations, and runaway costs.
* Multi-domain exposure and the curiosity to get fluent in a new industry fast.
* Sharp instincts for risk, change, vendor, and stakeholder management.

### **Extra Credit**

* PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CSPO, or an AI/cloud certification.
* Deep expertise in a specific industry.

### **Why Techdome?**

* **Work that matters:** Lead technically demanding, AI-driven projects that solve real problems across industries.
* **People who raise your game:** Collaborate with experienced designers, engineers, QA specialists, and AI experts.
* **A real seat at the table:** Shape how projects are planned, run, and delivered, not just follow a process someone else wrote.
* **Growth at the edge of AI:** Build expertise in one of the fastest-moving areas in tech, with projects that keep you learning.

title: Growth Marketer
description:
**About Snaphomz**  
Snaphomz is an AI-first PropTech platform helping people discover, evaluate, and navigate real estate decisions in the United States. We combine AI, data, and practical tools to make the homebuying experience more transparent and accessible.

**The Opportunity**  
We are hiring an energetic, resourceful, results-obsessed Growth Marketing Lead who can turn bold ideas into measurable acquisition, engagement, and conversion. You will work closely with the founder and leadership team, guide execution with our India-based marketing team, and build growth programs for U.S. audiences. This is a hands-on player-coach role: you will research, pitch, test, launch, measure, and improve—not simply assign tasks or report activity.

**What You Will Own**  
**U.S. audience insights, content and viral ideas**  
· Research U.S. homebuyer pain points, social conversations, creator trends, emerging formats, competitor positioning, and regional opportunities; translate insights into weekly campaign ideas.  
· Develop distinctive, culturally relevant content concepts, social hooks, short-form video briefs, UGC campaigns, community activations, referral loops, and responsible guerrilla/growth experiments.  
· Build an experimentation backlog; define hypotheses, target audiences, success criteria, owners, budgets, and deadlines for each test.  
**Organic, social and community growth**  
· Grow relevant audiences and qualified website traffic through SEO, content distribution, social channels, creator partnerships, community participation, and partnerships.  
· Coordinate content calendars and execution across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, and Reddit where audience fit is demonstrated.  
· Prioritize engagement quality, sign-ups, qualified leads, and activated users—not follower counts or impressions in isolation.  
**Paid acquisition and conversion**  
· Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns on Meta, Google, TikTok, and other appropriate channels; manage targeting, creatives, landing pages, budgets, and testing.  
· Track spend, attribution, funnel conversion, cost per qualified lead, customer acquisition cost, and return on spend where measurable; reallocate budget based on evidence.  
· Partner with product and design teams to improve landing pages, onboarding, activation, retargeting, and A/B testing.  
**Email and lifecycle marketing**  
· Own email strategy across acquisition, onboarding, nurturing, re-engagement, and conversion, including segmentation, personalization, automation, and testing.  
· Monitor deliverability, list quality, open/click trends, replies, qualified actions, and downstream conversion; improve campaigns based on cohort performance.  
**Team execution and leadership**  
· Work directly with founders and leadership to convert business priorities into weekly growth plans, clear briefs, owners, milestones, and measurable deliverables.  
· Coordinate and oversee day-to-day delivery with the India-based marketing team, including content, creatives, campaigns, SEO, email, and reporting; provide constructive feedback and remove blockers.  
· Lead weekly growth reviews: share what launched, what worked, what failed, learnings, next experiments, and decisions required.  
· Use AI and automation tools thoughtfully to speed up research, production, workflows, and analysis while ensuring accuracy and brand quality.

**What We Are Looking For**  
· 2–5 years in growth, digital, or performance marketing, with evidence of campaigns you personally drove and their measurable outcomes.  
· Practical knowledge of U.S. consumer audiences, social trends, messaging, and channel dynamics; ability to research local market differences.  
· Hands-on competence in Meta/Google advertising, SEO/content distribution, email automation, analytics, attribution, and conversion-rate optimization.  
· Working familiarity with GA4, Search Console, Tag Manager, ad managers, CRM/email platforms, and reporting dashboards.  
· A strong creative instinct paired with analytical rigor: you can pitch unconventional ideas and validate them with disciplined experiments.  
· Excellent English communication, cross-functional coordination, prioritization, and the confidence to challenge weak ideas with evidence.  
· High ownership, speed, curiosity, resilience, and willingness to execute personally in a fast-moving startup.

**Nice to Have**  
· Experience in U.S. real estate, PropTech, consumer technology, SaaS, or marketplaces.  
· Track record of creator/influencer partnerships, viral campaigns, referral growth, and community-led acquisition.  
· Experience guiding a small marketing team or coordinating agencies and freelancers.  
· Knowledge of AI-powered marketing workflows and U.S. housing advertising compliance.

**How Success Will Be Measured**  
· Growth in qualified U.S. sign-ups, activated users, leads, and attributable conversions.  
· Sustainable organic search and social growth, with measurable contribution to acquisition.  
· Paid campaign efficiency: qualified lead cost, acquisition cost, conversion rate, and budget discipline.  
· Email-driven engagement, activation, reactivation, and conversions.  
· Speed and quality of experiments launched, learnings applied, and team delivery against agreed priorities.

**Compensation and Performance Bonus**  
Competitive compensation based on experience and demonstrated ability, plus eligibility for a performance-based bonus. Bonus goals, measurement windows, attribution rules, payout timing, and eligibility conditions will be agreed in writing. Awards may reflect qualified organic/channel growth, attributable conversions, effective paid campaign management, and overall growth impact. A bonus is not guaranteed solely for increased followers, impressions, or ad spend.

**Why Join Snaphomz?**  
Work closely with leadership, influence growth strategy, own meaningful campaigns end to end, and help build an AI-first product for the U.S. real estate market. We value initiative, experimentation, accountability, and visible results.

title: Senior Technical Product Owner
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. We are looking for a **Senior Technical Product Owner** to drive the vision, roadmap, and delivery of key digital products, including FinOps and AI agent solutions. **What you will Own**

* **FinOps.** Our FinOps products give engineering teams and finance a shared, trustworthy view of cloud spend across our providers and push cost accountability into the teams that create the cost. You own their vision, roadmap and backlog end to end.
* **Discovery for what comes next.** New products are taking shape in our cloud and platform strategy area. You will help develop them through product discovery, prototypes and stakeholder interviews, and give them a definition and a first roadmap. Who owns them in the end is decided later.
* **Possibly more.** Depending on the profile we find, smaller existing products can be added to your responsibilities – our Backstage developer portal, or our Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud offerings, for example.
* **Outcomes, not output.** You are measured on adoption across the applications on the platform and on the decisions that change because of your product, not on the number of stories closed. You present your roadmap and your results to leadership yourself.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Talk to the people who use our FinOps products – platform teams, application teams and finance – and turn what you learn into a roadmap they recognise as theirs.
* Write the user stories and acceptance criteria yourself. You know the difference between a story and a specification.
* Prioritise against business value, technical feasibility and the platform strategy, and defend the ranking when it is challenged.
* Work with the engineering team day to day: refinement, design reviews, demos and releases. You can read the code and the architecture, and you will.
* Track adoption and outcomes, and act on what the numbers tell you.
* Manage expectations and dependencies with stakeholders across WSA.
* Run product discovery and stakeholder interviews for new products in the strategy area

**What you bring**
------------------

* A technical background: 5\+ years in software engineering, architecture or platform engineering, and real responsibility for deciding what gets built – as a product owner, a tech lead or an architect.
* You have shipped something other teams depend on – an internal platform, a service, a tool – and lived with the consequences.
* You understand cloud platforms well enough to challenge an engineer's estimate and to spot when a cost report is wrong. Hands\-on FinOps experience is a plus; the practice can be learned, the instinct cannot.

* You can work with an empowered agile team without needing to run it. Scrum or SAFe familiarity is useful; process for its own sake is not.
* You are interested in LLM\- and agent\-based solutions and have a realistic view of what they can and cannot do today.
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfortable working in a multi\-region team across time zones..

At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.

With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.

description:

We are looking for a highly motivated Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our System Manager team.

* Experience with SPDM, PLDM, MCTP protocols
* Experience with Caliptra, Crypto/security APIs
* Experience with bootloaders and platform firmware, including initialization, boot flows, reset handling, recovery, and firmware\-update mechanisms.
* Understanding of firmware authentication/signature verification, OTP provisioning
